text:
Maya: Quick sync 10m. Need final cuts for observability sprint: token-level spend, sampled error payloads, and quick alerts. Customers prioritized token spend + error samples.

Ethan: TL;DR: token rollups cheap (use tokenizer output), sampler needs retention policy and redaction, alerts are nice-to-have alpha.

Sofia: Two customer asks: daily per-route spend export; error samples grouped by model+route with redacted text. They want CSV exports.

Ben: Constraints: Dedicated/private deploys cannot phone home. We need an agent write-path or local-only export option. Also perf: sampler must be async (p99 <1ms).

Maya: Proposed cut: 1) Ship token rollups + CSV export (MVP). 2) Ship redacted error sampler (3d retention default, configurable). 3) Alerts behind flag for later. Acceptance: feature flag, export examples, perf tests, legal sign-off for exports.

Ethan: Implementation options for spend attribution:
- Fast: use routing metadata/token counts emitted by runtime (~2 dev days)
- Accurate: join billing events (~5+ days)
I'll doc pros/cons.

Sofia: I'll add two customer export samples to the ticket and confirm required columns.

Ben: Ops: will draft agent plan for private clusters and retention lifecycle job. ops-bot: snapshot created for branch obs/token-sampler (build 5201).

Maya: Action items: Ethan draft tech approach by noon, Ben + Ops produce infra estimate, Sofia update PRD with CSV schema and legal notes. We'll lock cuts at 3pm.
